files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A section with a heading and the features as a grid of cards or tiles, or as rows with a picture. Icons are
  Lucide names. Axes: layout (grid, rows), columns, item (card, tile, cell: bordered tile with a round icon),
  media side (rows), density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
import type { HeadLink } from "../components/section-frame.types";

export type FeatureGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  features: Feature[];
  empty?: string;
  action?: HeadLink;
  layout?: "grid" | "rows";
  cols?: "1-2" | "1-3" | "1-4";
  item?: "card" | "tile" | "cell";
  mediaSide?: "end" | "start" | "alternate";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Link from "../compose/Link.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import FeatureCards from "../components/feature-cards.vue";
import FeatureRows from "../components/feature-rows.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  features,
  empty = "",
  action,
  layout = "grid",
  cols = "1-3",
  item = "card",
  mediaSide = "end",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<FeatureGridProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame v-if="((item as string) === 'cell')"
    :id="id"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    measure="fill"
    class="py-0"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="w-full">
      <Title :as="2" size="sm" weight="semibold" class="leading-7" :id="(id + '-title')">
        {{ title }}
      </Title>
      <Link v-if="(action?.label && action?.href)"
        :href="urlOf(action?.href)"
        variant="default"
        :class="cn(defaults.text.tiny, 'shrink-0 font-medium leading-5')"
        data-testid="section-action"
      >
        {{ action?.label }}
      </Link>
    </Group>
    <EmptyState v-if="((features?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="layout-grid" :title="empty" />
    <FeatureCards v-else :features="features" :cols="cols" :item="item" />
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-else
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :action="action"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <EmptyState v-if="((features?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="layout-grid" :title="empty" />
    <FeatureRows v-else-if="((layout as string) === 'rows')" :features="features" :mediaSide="mediaSide" />
    <FeatureCards v-else :features="features" :cols="cols" :item="item" />
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
